questions.stem: My father works in a ____ (shoe) factory.
questions.explanation: shoe 作定语保持单数：a shoe factory。

questions.stem: We planted twenty ____ (banana tree) last spring.

options.distractor: 作定语的 banana 不变复数
twenty 后面中心词要变复数
变复数的应是中心词 tree

questions.explanation: banana 作定语不变，tree 变复数：banana trees。

questions.stem: There are three ____ (woman doctor) in the hospital.

options.distractor: woman 作定语要跟着变复数

questions.explanation: woman 作定语随中心词变复数：women doctors。

questions.stem: The ____ (boy student) are having a basketball match.

options.distractor: 谓语是 are，主语要用复数
变复数的应是中心词 student

questions.explanation: boy 作定语不变，student 变复数：boy students。

options.text: There is a book shop near our school.
They are men workers in the factory.
We have four pencil-boxs in the bag.
She bought two sports shoes shops.
options.distractor: 结构错误，但这是下面要判断的干扰项

questions.explanation: pencil-box 的复数应是 pencil-boxes（x 结尾加 -es）。

questions.stem: Our school has two ____ halls and a big ____ field.

options.distractor: sport 作定语通常用复数形式 sports
两个空都要用 sports 作定语

questions.explanation: sports 是固定作定语的复数形式：sports hall、sports field。
